# Intelense

> Intelense builds edge AI video analytics products for retail, workplace safety, smart homes, agriculture, IoT, and autonomous robotics. Six modular AI products — KenVision, KenSafety, KenHome, KenAgri, KenIoT, KenRobotics — powered by a single unified engine called Ken360. Works with existing cameras. No hardware replacement needed. Deploys in under 48 hours.

Founded 2018 by Dinesh Prasanna (MIT TLP). Headquartered in Canada with operations in India. Backed by AWS, GCP, NVIDIA, and IBM partnerships.

## Products

- [KenVision](https://www.intelense.com/llms/kenvision.md): AI video intelligence — footfall analytics, zone heatmaps, queue detection, dwell time, conversion tracking. 95% accuracy, <3s latency.
- [KenSafety](https://www.intelense.com/llms/kensafety.md): Workplace safety AI — PPE compliance, hazard zone detection, fire/smoke alerts, fall detection, automated incident reports. 95% PPE accuracy, 80% incident reduction.
- [KenHome](https://www.intelense.com/llms/kenhome.md): Smart home security AI — intruder detection, elderly/child monitoring, pet hazard alerts, vehicle protection. 97% accuracy, <5s alerts.
- [KenAgri](https://www.intelense.com/llms/kenagri.md): Precision agriculture AI — crop health monitoring, yield prediction, pest/disease detection, automated irrigation across satellite, drone, IoT, and ground cameras. 30% yield increase.
- [KenIoT](https://www.intelense.com/llms/keniot.md): IoT sensor analytics — predictive failure detection, real-time anomaly alerts, automated maintenance scheduling across railways, defence, healthcare, fleet.
- [KenRobotics](https://www.intelense.com/llms/kenrobotics.md): Autonomous systems AI — real-time perception, dynamic path planning, multi-robot coordination, fleet management. <3s perception latency.
- [Ken360](https://www.intelense.com/llms/ken360.md): The unified AI platform connecting all six Ken modules — one API, one dashboard, shared data model, edge + cloud architecture.

## Industries

Retail, Construction, Manufacturing, Public Safety, Smart Cities, Healthcare, Commercial Real Estate, Hotels, Warehouse, Precision Agriculture, Smart Campuses.

## Solutions

- [Retail Analytics](https://www.intelense.com/llms/retail-analytics.md): AI-powered retail analytics using existing CCTV — footfall, heatmaps, queue monitoring, conversion tracking. 95% footfall accuracy, 28% conversion lift.
